mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is not significantly negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.4 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which forecasts higher future consumption and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 50% of cases when HOUST > 1.4M, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening manufacturing sector and labor market stress, indicating an impending economic slowdown that reduces corporate profitability and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20d returns in fewer than 55% of cases when both INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or the interaction term's Rank IC is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 323.0 with a 12-month increase exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflationary pressure that forces the Fed to maintain high policy rates, increasing equity discount rates and suppressing forward S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is not significantly negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 725 billion dollars, combined with rising housing starts, signals strong aggregate demand and rising consumer spending, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in less than 55% of cases when both RSAFS > 725B and HOUST > 1.4M, or the interaction term's Rank IC is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in payroll employment growth below 50,000 jobs per month signals weakening labor market momentum, which reduces consumer spending and corporate hiring expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in fewer than 50% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 50k, or the signal's Rank IC is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP growth below 1.0% annualized, as measured by GDPC1, signals a weakening economy that reduces corporate earnings expectations and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60d returns in less than 55% of cases when GDPC1 growth < 1.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
